source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 22 Apr 1927 p12 'Derry Rural', read in the block image (BNL19270422.2.233 area 5): 'There will be no contests, and all the foregoing were declared elected. They are all former members of the Council.'

note: Triennial election of the thirteen divisions of Londonderry (Derry No. 1) rural district, one member each. Nominations were received on 21 April 1927 by A. W. Perry, J.P., returning officer; there were no contests and all were declared elected, all former members (Belfast News-Letter, 22 April 1927, p. 12). Polled Friday 27 May 1927: 'Polling took place yesterday in the Bellarena division of county Londonderry, the only division in the county where there was a contest' for the county council (Londonderry Sentinel, Saturday 28 May 1927, p. 8), and the Limavady rural contest in Straw 'took place on Friday' (Derry Journal, 30 May 1927, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
